original.target_description: Original full text could not be obtained through permitted open-access routes. Assigned study, outcome and test locators were empty. The replication report identifies its target as H4, openness to experience predicting leadership experiences in retained SEM Model 1; this could not be independently verified against the original paper.

replication.target_description: Single-trace claim 4 / H4: positive relationship between openness to experience and leadership experiences in retained Model 1, structural equation modeling with maximum likelihood and three parcels per measure; U.S. men aged 18 or older with military experience, final analytic sample. Report title, original reference and SCORE RR ID 23w12 match the supplied replication reference. The report uniquely identifies this focal claim despite empty input locators.

notes: No input study identifiers, neutral description or effect locators were supplied. The linked primary replication report identifies one focal claim, H4, so replication values refer to that claim. Standardized beta is printed; the same passage also prints unstandardized b = 0.164. Requested es_type ser_method supplies no named metric. The report quotes original beta = .34 and p < .01, but original-side values remain null because original full text was unavailable and the quotation was not independently verified. Original title verified using OpenAlex and DOI metadata. Acquisition routes: DOI landing page redirected to Elsevier; ScienceDirect returned 403 and was not retried; Unpaywall had no OA locations; OpenAlex indicated closed with no repository full text; Europe PMC returned zero DOI matches; title/DOI open-access searches found metadata and unrelated citing papers only. Replication file API verified report name and project 7k8sy; downloaded full PDF and parsed text. Authors note reduced sample relative to the preregistered target and caution on power; this does not replace their explicit successful-replication verdict.
